name: Domain-based BVH with Range Bounding Boxes
definition: An acceleration structure using a Bounding Volume Hierarchy (BVH) over the domain, where nodes store lists of tetrahedra whose Range Bounding Boxes (RBBs) are included in the node's RBB, allowing filtering via 2-D intersection tests in range space.
summary: Domain-based BVH with Range Bounding Boxes is a fiber surface extraction acceleration structure that uses 2-D range-space filtering to return fewer tetrahedra with less memory than domain-based octrees.
